records.issue_text: TablesList in pkg/expr/sql/parser.go calls duckDB.RunCommands which always errors with the stub, so dependency resolution for SQL expressions fails before Execute, and the 'not implemented' error gives no indication the backend was intentionally removed
records.rationale: In pkg/expr/sql/db.go, DB.RunCommands (and other DB methods) are stubs that always return errors.New("not implemented"). In pkg/expr/sql/parser.go, TablesList now constructs duckDB := NewInMemoryDB() and then calls duckDB.RunCommands(...), which will therefore always error, breaking TablesList functionality compared to the prior go-duck implementation.
